topics.topic: Specify ACTIVE and REVOKED as members of models.GrantStatus
questions: The passage must name active and revoked as the ACTIVE and REVOKED members of = models.GrantStatus rather than referring to enum states only by prose values.

quotes: assign_staff_project: [BEHAVIOR] MUST, when get_staff_assignment finds no active assignment for the pair, insert a new assignment built exactly as for a pair that never had one, whether or not revoked assignments of the pair are stored; it writes no assignment other than the one it creates, so a revoked one is never updated or reactivated.
judgement.why: The note refers to the GrantStatus states only as prose values instead of naming the ACTIVE and REVOKED enum members beside the models.GrantStatus address.
judgement.rule: **Член перечисления** note называет его именем рядом с адресом перечисления: `the EXPENSE_CREATE member of = models.AuditAction`.

topics.topic: Use canonical models.GrantStatus enum members and expose the model address to the prompt
questions: Replace the prose status names “active” and “revoked” with the ACTIVE and REVOKED members of = models.GrantStatus, and make that canonical model address available to the prompt.

author_guidance: Before editing, identify the decision's owning state from the phase purpose, question_scope and layer obligations, then choose a disposition for each topic that awaits one.
fixed: repair a decision the owning state must make; do not add later-layer implementation choices merely to close a topic. Record the fix commit and review the changed text once.

carried: name the receiving layer and use --what to preserve the choice, its options and consequences, and the required guarantee every option must keep. Decide any guarantee owned here before carrying its execution onward.
accepted: explain why the remaining choice is permitted. Bring an unresolved product choice to the owner with its options and consequences; absence of a quoted requirement does not decide it.
contradiction and standard_violation take no disposition: repair the offending text in its owning state and review the change. Deterministic transition findings must also close through their checks.
